The climate in Blagoevgrad

Blagoevgrad is about 390 m above sea level. The warmest month is August, with an average high of 31°C; the coldest is January, when nights average −3°C. Around 660 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in March (about 82 mm). The highest temperature in Blagoevgrad in 2015–2024 was 40°C (1 July 2017) and the lowest −23°C (8 January 2017).

Blagoevgrad lies in the Struma valley between Rila and Pirin. Warm Mediterranean air comes up the valley from the south, so summers are hot and winters milder than the altitude would suggest. The surrounding mountains catch the clouds, so the area around gets much more rain and snow than the city itself.

Best time to visit Blagoevgrad

The most pleasant weather in Blagoevgrad is usually in May, June, September and October: average highs are between 20°C and 27°C, with up to 10 days of rain a month. In July and August it is hot, over 30°C in the afternoon on average.
